name: protein phosphatase 4 regulatory subunit 2
pathways: regulation of double-strand break repair via homologous recombination

function.text: PPP4R2 encodes serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 4 regulatory subunit 2. Annotated molecular activities include protein-macromolecule adaptor activity and protein phosphatase regulator activity. It participates in regulation of double-strand break repair via homologous recombination and protein modification process.
